research.title: Composition — Early Years
research.treatment: See parts and whole together; recombine disjoint groups without changing their total.
research.adopted: Visible parts move to one collection. Small direct sums, repeated equal parts and optional count support.
research.rejected: Do not require naming objects, counting taps or all hidden-part/inverse-operation work. Do not substitute prepared-answer recognition for free sentence construction.
research.usageRestrictions: Original text/figures not copied. NCETM default Crown Copyright/OGL attribution; named-author and third-party exceptions apply. Rights checked https://www.ncetm.org.uk/copyright/ . No source licence transfer to supplied mascot artwork.
research.limitations: Foreign early-years conceptual guidance, younger than Finnish grades1–2; adaptation is a project decision. Not a lesson trial, Finnish curriculum mapping or effectiveness/retention evidence.

inventory.intro: Loikka and Aava join picnic portions.
inventory.demo: Actual joinScene3+2 and4+3: per-piece joining, continued count, final equation.
inventory.generators: join1–5+1–5; expr1–6+1–4; sentence1–5+1–4 fact build with reusable number tokens; transfer2–4+1–3+1.
inventory.hint: Count all or continue from the first part; include all original portions.
inventory.feedback: Part vs whole, one too many/few; sentence fact mode accepts swapped operands.
inventory.media: countanim joinScene; no ADD01 motion overlay.
inventory.registry: cases selects join/expr/sentence except separate three-part transfer; no ADD01 family or coverage overlay.
inventory.audit: Reports joining animation, sentence construction and hints; immutable audit is unapproved history.

alignment.inherited: Combine disjoint sets; all pieces retained; direct total and supported mathematical notation.
alignment.extended: Direct numeric answer, equal repeated parts, visible source conservation, optional marks and dense boundary validation.
alignment.corrected: Marker completion or observation is not required to answer. Fixed sentence completion is not free expression construction or evidence of independent competence.

currentSource.scope: Current Lite source bytes; sourceFiles/sourceHashes outside currentSource remain historical supplied-snapshot provenance.
currentSource.reviewBoundary: Source binding only. Current content/alignment decisions and technical evidence are separate; teacher and learner validation remain pending.

planning.childGoal: Yhdistän kaksi määrää ja kerron yhteisen määrän.

canonicalPrerequisiteGroups.rationale: v0.1:n required-esitiedot siirretty v0.2:ssa eksplisiittiseen AND-ryhmään.

planning.assumed: M-NUM-02 cardinality and its counting ancestry. Small numeral reading/writing supported by adult if needed; names/species, spoken confirmation and a marking procedure are not required.
coTaught: M-SYM-PLUS (optional notation introduced, no hard prerequisite or mastery credit)
M-SYM-EQUAL (optional equality meaning introduced, no hard prerequisite or mastery credit)
planning.scope: Two positive disjoint parts with total at most10. Optional equal-part cases, supplied sentence slots and three-part extension. No broad arithmetic fluency or unaided free expression construction claim.
planning.evidenceLimits: Assisted low-stakes response in supplied context. Model and marks visible; no persistent personal evidence, formal mastery, independence or retention inference.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Canonical direct-curriculum grades1–2 atomic node and exact M-NUM-02 AND group preserved. NCETM is foreign conceptual corroboration, not new OPH authority. Example counts, movement path, numbering and scaffolds are project design.
planning.assetProvenance: Original deterministic SVG and renderer; supplied unchanged Loikka happy/Aava curious transparent PNGs. No mascot redraw or invented pose. Public release/licensing holds retained.

extensions.playback: 1.2 pieces per playback second is illustrative pacing, not physical duration measurement.
extensions.data: No personal or learner history. Optional marks indicate only local support.

audienceMigration.method: bounded source-role/step annotation with separately recorded author corrections
